goal:
The geometry package in this project works, except that each of its sixteen modules contains exactly one defect. Find and fix all sixteen so that test_geometry.py passes all 28 checks.

Every module is real, working code apart from its one fault, and the faults are all different kinds of wrong - an off-by-one, an inverted comparison, a wrong operator, a swapped pair, an argument that gets mutated. There is no single pattern to search for: each has to be found by reading the module and working out what it is supposed to do. The docstrings say what each function is for, and the checks in the test file say precisely what is expected.

Do not change test_geometry.py. The checks describe the required behaviour, and editing them is not a fix.

The test reports every failing check rather than stopping at the first, so run it as you go to see what is left. Work module by module.

Verify by running: python test_geometry.py. Report the number of checks passing that you actually saw.
